package pxf_test

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"google.golang.org/protobuf/proto"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/reflect/protodesc"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/reflect/protoreflect"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/types/descriptorpb"
)

func TestGenCarrier(t *testing.T) {
	dir := os.Getenv("CARRIER_DIR")
	names, _ := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(dir, "*.proto"))
	for _, p := range names {
		src, _ := os.ReadFile(p)
		fd := compileV12(t, string(src))
		seen := map[string]bool{}
		var full descriptorpb.FileDescriptorSet
		var add func(f protoreflect.FileDescriptor)
		add = func(f protoreflect.FileDescriptor) {
			if seen[f.Path()] { return }
			seen[f.Path()] = true
			imps := f.Imports()
			for i := 0; i < imps.Len(); i++ { add(imps.Get(i).FileDescriptor) }
			full.File = append(full.File, protodesc.ToFileDescriptorProto(f))
		}
		add(fd)
		for _, f := range full.File {
			for _, m := range f.MessageType {
				var to, from *descriptorpb.FieldDescriptorProto
				var kept []*descriptorpb.FieldDescriptorProto
				for _, x := range m.Field {
					switch x.GetName() {
					case "target":
						to = x
					case "donor":
						from = x
						continue
					}
					kept = append(kept, x)
				}
				if from != nil {
					if to.Options == nil {
						to.Options = &descriptorpb.FieldOptions{}
					}
					proto.Merge(to.Options, from.Options)
					m.Field = kept
				}
			}
		}
		// The stripped set drops the schema files, so 1327 reaches a reader
		// as an unknown field, as it does a consumer without those imports.
		var bare descriptorpb.FileDescriptorSet
		for _, f := range full.File {
			if strings.HasPrefix(f.GetName(), "protowire/schema/") { continue }
			g := proto.Clone(f).(*descriptorpb.FileDescriptorProto)
			var deps []string
			for _, d := range g.Dependency {
				if !strings.HasPrefix(d, "protowire/schema/") { deps = append(deps, d) }
			}
			g.Dependency = deps
			g.PublicDependency, g.WeakDependency = nil, nil
			bare.File = append(bare.File, g)
		}
		base := strings.TrimSuffix(p, ".proto")
		for name, set := range map[string]*descriptorpb.FileDescriptorSet{base + ".binpb": &full, base + ".bare.binpb": &bare} {
			b, err := proto.MarshalOptions{Deterministic: true}.Marshal(set)
			if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
			if err := os.WriteFile(name, b, 0o644); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
		}
	}
}
